title: Fellowships: Postdoctoral
about: Long-term postdoctoral fellowships at the Library Company of Philadelphia for 2027-28, including the PAAH Mellon Scholars and PEAES fellowships. Applications are accepted until 17 January 2027; one application is considered for all eligible fellowships. Fellows reside in the Philadelphia area; no visa sponsorship.
requirements: PhD by September 1 of the residency year
Fellows must reside in the Philadelphia area for the duration of the fellowship
